definitions.explanation: Free from dirt or impurities. Often used for environments, objects, or personal cleanliness.
Morally clean or having a neat, wholesome appearance.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}を{清潔|せいけつ}に{保|たも}ってください。
{清潔|せいけつ}な{環境|かんきょう}が{大切|たいせつ}です。
{彼|かれ}は{清潔|せいけつ}な{印象|いんしょう}を{与|あた}える。

notes:
{清潔|せいけつ} is a na-adjective meaning clean or hygienic.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {清潔|せいけつ}に (cleanly)
- Noun modifier: {清潔|せいけつ}な + noun
- Noun form: {清潔|せいけつ}さ (cleanliness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {清潔|せいけつ}に{保|たも}つ (keep clean)
- {清潔|せいけつ}な{環境|かんきょう} (clean environment)
- {清潔|せいけつ}{感|かん} (sense of cleanliness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- きれい: clean, pretty (casual)
- {清潔|せいけつ}: clean, hygienic (formal)
- {衛生的|えいせいてき}: sanitary (technical)
